summary: reconcile --prune deletes local rows absent from a complete live key enumeration, closing the upstream-deletion gap the additive sync framework cannot cover for this API.
reason: Priority has no deletion feed and no tenant-scope body column, so the generated flat-reconcile path is unreachable (Greptile P1 on PR #1623); a full keyset sweep gated on provable completeness is the safe alternative.
validated_outcome: planted stale rows pruned on both typed-table (parts, 2885-key enumeration) and resources-only (warehouses) paths; incomplete enumeration aborts with zero deletes.
